author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices the eight-step ladder from C to C, climbing back up, walk and run-ning notes, song sections and two-hand teamwork, with a bright Christmas song.

classes.title: Down the eight-step ladder
classes.goal: Hear the song start on high C and walk down every white key to middle C.

mathTarget.parentLine: Eight white keys down, and you land on C again

classes.parentPrompt: Count the steps aloud with your child as the lights walk down: one to eight.
classes.childAction: Count eight steps down from high C to middle C.
classes.bridge: High C is the top of a ladder; middle C is the floor, same name.

intro.caption: Down the eight-step ladder
intro.parentCue: Count each step down out loud, one to eight

games.caption: Eight steps, C to C
games.parentCue: Count one to eight with the lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: eight steps from one C to the next.

classes.title: Climb back up to C
classes.goal: Play the second line, climbing from G back up to high C.

mathTarget.parentLine: The first line walks down; this line climbs back up

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers down your child's arm for line one, then up for line two.
classes.childAction: Thumb on G, then climb: G, A, B, up to C.
classes.bridge: Down the ladder, then halfway back up: G, A, B, C to the top.

intro.caption: Climb back up to C
intro.parentCue: Walk your fingers up your child's arm

games.caption: Climb up: G, A, B, C
games.parentCue: Say 'up, up, up, top!' with each key

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a line that climbs back up.

classes.title: Ladder part, singing part
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and notice its two parts.

mathTarget.parentLine: A ladder part first, then a repeating singing part

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up one finger for the ladder part, two for 'and heaven and nature sing'.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and show one or two fingers for each part.
classes.bridge: Part one goes down and up the ladder; part two sings the same line twice.

intro.caption: Ladder part, singing part
intro.parentCue: Show one finger, then two, for the parts

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing the two parts of a song.

classes.title: Walk, walk, run-ning
classes.goal: Practise the quick repeated notes slowly, then the same shape one key lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two quick run-ning notes fit in the time of one walk

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'run-ning, run-ning' on the quick Es; then the same on D, one key lower.
classes.childAction: Thumb runs on E five times, then up and back.
classes.bridge: Run-ning notes are quick feet; the second time, the runner starts one key lower.

intro.caption: Watch slowly
intro.parentCue: Say 'run-ning' on each pair of quick notes

games.caption: Five quick Es, then up
games.parentCue: Count the five quick Es out loud

games.caption: Same again, one key lower
games.parentCue: Help the thumb move down to D

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: walk and run-ning notes, two to one.

classes.title: Low C, the big bell
classes.goal: Play one low left hand note on the first beat of each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Four beats in each bar; the left hand plays on one

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune; count one-two-three-four, loud on one, for your child's low note.
classes.childAction: Left hand rings low C or low G on every one.
classes.bridge: Low C is a big church bell, C in a much lower house.

intro.caption: The big low bell
intro.parentCue: count to four, loud on one

games.caption: Big bells on one
games.parentCue: Say one loud with each low bell

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting four beats and playing on one.

classes.title: Bell and singers together
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left hand note on each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note lasts while four beats go by above

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'bell' on each low note.
classes.childAction: Left hand rings and holds; right hand sings the tune.
classes.bridge: Left hand is the big bell ringing once; right hand is the choir singing on.

intro.caption: Bell and singers together
intro.parentCue: Say 'bell' softly on each low note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands doing two jobs at once.

classes.title: Bouncy and bright
classes.goal: Play both hands together a little faster, then slow again if needed.

mathTarget.parentLine: The pattern stays the same when the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Bounce gently in your seat as the speed goes up; go back to slow if notes fall apart.
classes.childAction: Play both hands slowly, then a little quicker.
classes.bridge: A slow walk and a happy bounce: the same song, a different speed.

intro.caption: Bouncy and bright
intro.parentCue: Go back to slow if notes fall apart

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same song at two speeds.

classes.title: Sing with the whole world
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part in step while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit beside your child and nod on every one; cheer for keeping going, not for notes.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. If a note slips, keep going!
classes.bridge: The song invites everyone to sing along; we join in and keep going.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping your part in step with the music.

classes.title: A bright concert
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy with a bright, strong sound, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Choosing a big, happy sound without banging

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; announce the song, then clap and bow together.
classes.childAction: Play brightly for teddy, land home on C, then bow.
classes.bridge: Strong, happy fingers, like bells ringing for a celebration.

intro.caption: Play the whole song!
intro.parentCue: Seat teddy and announce the song together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song with a bright sound.
